name: Turael
notes: Replaced by Aya, his sister, during and after While Guthix Sleeps; Aya assigns the identical task list.
Can replace a task assigned by another master with an easier one, but only if the current task is not one Turael himself assigns; accepting the replacement resets the task streak to zero.
Cannot reassign a task that he (or Aya) gave out.
Completed tasks award no points but still count toward the four completions needed before points start accruing, and they advance the streak toward the 10th/50th/100th/250th/1000th milestone bonuses.
Block list is shared with Spria and Aya.
Asking Turael or Aya for a new assignment reveals the current streak count when the held task is not one they assign; confirming the dialogue takes the replacement and resets the streak.
